notes: ceilescape-01 (OWNER 2026-10-23 "do whatever you recommend": the board-a-Comet escape fix, a named exception to the no-stuck-hunts rule). THE CHANGE: a ramp swing whose price (bot.digTime: the held item, eye water, onGround -- mineflayer fixes the wait at dig start) does not fit the time left is never started. Under an unaffordable ceiling the cheapest sidestep that fits is taken (floodSidestep, wet feet allowed for a submerged start, cellFloods on the head cell, fire-column veto); a first step swing that fits no fresh firing escalates (_needs_rescue, the fleetstatus line). CEILESCAPE=0 = the base exactly apart from the rows (tested trace for trace against the base module). MEASURED 7 d to 10-24: 3 bots with ramp stops "dig exceeded" -- board-a-Comet 864 (copper over a falling-water column, lateral exit east), placebo-c-Bravo 1,331 (sealed; placebo-c is never drawable), placebo-a-Alpha 2. Record: docs/reports/ceilescape-01-design-2026-10-24.md. TIER 3: drawexposure (6 h, entombed_ramp_cut ~ dig exceeded >= 2) finds board-a only.

draw_exposure.note: draw_require_pools ["board-a"]: board-a-Comet is the one bot the fix can free. A kind-based requirement would make drawexposure refuse (one pool, two needed), as for poolescape-01.

exposure.note: >= 1 canary _ceilescape row with action != ceiling (Comet writes one at its first ramp firing).

own_lines.note: PRIMARY (BLOCKS KEEP, deterministic, n = 1): board-a-Comet leaves its column (x 359-360, z 186-188, y 38.5-41) after the deploy and stays out >= 30 min of its own positions. Paper: candidate left in 168 s; base stayed.
G1: canary deaths within 120 s after a _ceilescape action=lateral row of the same bot -- the two-death floor (one is reported).
G2: a licence-on _ceilescape row with env_ms <= left_ms and action != ceiling (an affordable swing must take today's path).
G3: a firing whose own last _ceilescape row says wait|escalate and whose ramp_cut row reads dig exceeded.
ARMS: a control _ceilescape* / _needs_rescue row after the deploy. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS: a canary licence on=1. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
INSTRUMENT: board-a-Comet positions in >= 75% of its post 10-min buckets. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED: actions by bot, _needs_rescue by cell, ceiling firings that still ended dig exceeded (near vs far; far >= 2 is a WATCH on the price model), the no-air-route hold seam, every canary death.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (immobiledid). POST-PROMOTION TRIPWIRE (both engines r2, step 0): run ceilescaperead.py --fleet 2880 48 h after promotion and report every _ceilescape row with action != ceiling fleet-wide, by bot, plus G2/G3.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. World changes: the lateral exit's own digs (a ladder and dirt beside board-a-Comet), left. Rollback without a canary: CEILESCAPE=0. Host-side: scripts/host/ceilescape/patch_fleetstatus.py (the coordinator runs it; idempotent, anchored, backed up).
